items.claim: Official Hays scam-alert page warns that scammers may pose as Hays recruiters via email, social media or SMS, and asks for personal details or money. Hays states it will never ask candidates for direct payment. This is a group-wide warning; no Singapore-specific notice appears on the page.
items.entity_the_claim_is_about: Hays group (impersonated by scammers; not misconduct by Hays)
items.quoted_evidence: Hays "will never ask a candidate for any form of direct payment"

items.claim: Hays Germany published a fraud warning stating that genuine Hays emails come from specific Hays domains and that Hays does not generally use private channels such as Telegram. Group-wide, not Singapore-specific; page not read.
items.quoted_evidence: Warning against fraud (page title, from search result; quoted domain list is from a search-summary, not verified on the page)

items.claim: A third-party malware-focused blog warns of a fake 'Hays Recruitment' job offer scam in which a fake hiring manager moves victims to WhatsApp or Telegram and may ask for a processing or equipment fee. Secondary, non-authoritative source; not read.
items.entity_the_claim_is_about: Hays Recruitment (name used by scammers; not misconduct by Hays)
items.quoted_evidence: Warning! Don't Fall for the Fake Hays Recruitment Job Offer Scam (headline, from search result)

notes: No regulator, licence, court or enforcement action against Hays Specialist Recruitment Pte Ltd (Singapore) was found. Searches for the Pte Ltd name returned only UK matters, and the Pte Ltd name was not matched to any case. Licence status with MOM was not confirmed; the search did not return the MOM licence record, and the licence-bond figures seen were from secondary guides only. No Singapore-specific retrenchment news about Hays was found. Singapore-wide retrenchment statistics for 2024 and 2025 were seen but are not about Hays and were omitted from items. A 2021 Singapore Police advisory on recruiters on job portals using foreign WhatsApp numbers was seen but does not name Hays, so it was omitted. Glassdoor overall rating (3.7 from about 8,147 reviews) was seen in a search summary and is not a red flag, so it was omitted. Only one page read succeeded (hays.com scam-alert); the Glassdoor review page returned HTTP 403, so Glassdoor items rely on search-result titles and summaries. Items drawn from search summaries rather than page reads are noted in quoted_evidence. Searches used: 6 of 8. Page reads used: 2 of 4 (1 succeeded, 1 failed). Suggested checks not performed: MOM licensed employment agency list, ACRA register for the Pte Ltd, Singapore eLitigation and Employment Claims Tribunal records.
